name: lease-contract-assertions
command:
env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -c $'import json,re
from pathlib import Path
root=Path("features/kv-pool-layerwise-reuse/evidence/full-validation-rerun-20260731T064607Z/lease")
summary=json.loads((root/"lease-summary.json").read_text())
assert summary["passed"] and not summary["errors"] and all(case["passed"] for case in summary["cases"]) and all(item["passed"] for item in summary["cleanup"])
assert summary["config"]=={"lease_ttl_ms":30000,"num_keys":1,"num_layers":2,"object_size":8192,"page_size":4096,"wait_margin_ms":1500,"wait_ms":31500}
assert len(summary["waits"])==2 and {item["phase"] for item in summary["waits"]}=={"between_put_layers","between_get_layers"}
assert all(item["requested_ms"]==31500 and item["elapsed_ms"]>=31500 for item in summary["waits"]),summary["waits"]
semantic=summary["semantic_result"]
assert semantic=={"expired_session_error_code":-707,"fresh_batch_get_session_start_after_expiry_finds_object":True,"old_get_session_survives_ttl":False,"slow_put_completed_after_read_ttl_gap":True}
calls=summary["api_calls"]; ops=[call["operation"] for call in calls]
put_end=next(i for i,call in enumerate(calls) if call["operation"]=="batch_put_session_end")
first_get=next(i for i,call in enumerate(calls) if call["operation"]=="batch_get_session_start")
assert put_end<first_get
expired=next(call for call in calls if call["phase"]=="read_layer_1_expired_session")
fresh_start=next(call for call in calls if call["phase"]=="fresh_read_session" and call["operation"]=="batch_get_session_start")
fresh_read=next(call for call in calls if call["phase"]=="read_layer_1_fresh_session")
assert expired["result"]==[-707] and fresh_start["result"]==[0] and fresh_read["result"]==[4096]
cases={case["name"]:case for case in summary["cases"]}
assert cases["two_layer_data_matches_after_fresh_lease"]["actual"] is True
deployment=(root/"master-deployment.yaml").read_text(); startup=(root/"master-startup.log").read_text()
assert "--default_kv_lease_ttl=30s" in deployment
for metric_file in ("preflight.metrics","post-driver.metrics"):
    text=(root/metric_file).read_text()
    for name in ("master_key_count","master_allocated_bytes","master_active_clients"):
        match=re.search(rf"^{name} ([0-9.eE+-]+)$",text,re.M); assert match and float(match.group(1))==0,(metric_file,name)
assert "| OK" in (root/"npu-after-lease.txt").read_text()
print(json.dumps({"validated":True,"lease_ttl_ms":30000,"wait_margin_ms":1500,"waits":summary["waits"],"slow_put_after_gap":True,"no_precommit_get":True,"stale_read_code":-707,"fresh_read_start":0,"fresh_read_bytes":4096,"two_layer_bytes_equal":True,"cleanup":True,"post_driver_empty":True},sort_keys=True,indent=2))'
